result.text:
# acme-web

The storefront for Acme, rebuilt on the new design system (@acme/tokens and @acme/ui).

## Where things are

- `apps/web`: the Next.js storefront
- `packages/ui`: shared components
- `packages/tokens`: colours, type and spacing

## Now

The checkout's Apple Pay button (T12), search ranking (T14) and the image CDN move (T15, in review).

# Memory

- [Design system](memory/design-system.md): tokens first, no raw colours
- [Checkout](memory/checkout.md): payments go through the billing-api
- [Testing](memory/testing.md): run the cart tests three times before calling them fixed

# Design system

## Decided

- Every colour comes from `@acme/tokens`; a raw hex in a component fails lint.
- Dark mode follows the system setting; there is no in-app switch (user, 2026-10-24).

## Watch out

- The high-contrast set is its own token file: a new token needs a value there too.

# Checkout

## Decided

- Payments go through billing-api's `/charges`, never Stripe directly from the web app.
- Apple Pay shows only on Safari with a card in the wallet.

## Ruled out

- A one-page checkout: the address step stays separate for tax.

# Testing

- `pnpm test` runs everything; `pnpm test --filter web` just the storefront.
- The cart tests are timing-sensitive: run them **three times** before calling one fixed (T16).
